name: Vify Order Printer
summary: Shopify invoice and order printer app: customisable PDF invoices, packing slips, refunds, quotes and B2B invoices with VAT numbers, in several languages and currencies, with bulk printing and automatic invoice emails.
best_for: Shopify stores that want branded PDF invoices, packing slips and refunds emailed automatically with each order, including B2B and multi-language invoices
skip_if: you only print an occasional packing slip, which a free app covers, or you need a confirmed e-invoicing format before you know which plan includes it
honest_knock: Free only reaches your 50 latest orders and keeps Vify's branding; unlimited orders and automatic invoice emails start on the $10.99 Starter plan, and invoices from your own sender address on the $29.99 Premium plan. The listing advertises Peppol, ZUGFeRD and Factur-X e-invoicing and B2B VAT numbers without saying which plan includes them, and the developer API on the $69.99 plan is still listed as coming soon. We have not used the app ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month, or $109 a year
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-11 on the Shopify App Store listing apps.shopify.com/vify-order-printer, USD; the listing says recurring charges are billed every 30 days) Four plans. Free: freely customised templates, the 50 latest orders, PDF invoice download for customers on the storefront, auto-detected address formats, draft orders and 24/7 support. Starter is $10.99 a month or $109 a year (the listing says save 17%) and adds bulk processing, branding removal, unlimited orders, automatic PDF invoices by email, invoice editing, custom invoice numbers and language detection. Premium is $29.99 a month or $299 a year and adds more templates, custom invoices and quotes, a custom sender email, commercial invoices, product metafields and free customisation. Ultimate is $69.99 a month or $699 a year and adds priority live chat support and free custom templates tailored to your design; its developer API is listed as coming soon. Every paid plan has a 14-day free trial. The listing also says the app supports the European e-invoicing standards Peppol, ZUGFeRD and Factur-X and captures customer VAT numbers on B2B invoices, without saying which plan those belong to.

schema_offer.description: Starter, per month, or $109 a year; unlimited orders, bulk processing, branding removal and automatic PDF invoices by email; Free covers the 50 latest orders; Premium $29.99, Ultimate $69.99. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-10-11.

free_plan_evidence: Free: freely customised templates, the 50 latest orders, PDF invoice download for customers on the storefront, auto-detected address formats, draft orders and 24/7 support.

compare_with.name: Shopify Order Printer
compare_with.why: Shopify's own Order Printer app is free and listed for pick lists, invoices and packing slips. Vify is the step up when you need invoices emailed automatically, unlimited order history, B2B VAT numbers, commercial invoices or a European e-invoice format. If you only print a packing slip now and then, start with the free option.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Vify Order Printer on a Shopify development store: the install on the Free plan, an invoice for a test order in about 1 minute and 3 clicks (the tab stayed on the print dialog, so the evidence image is our own local rendering of the invoice HTML and not a screenshot of the PDF), the plan screen, the Shopify approval screen for Starter (not approved, a payment method was asked) and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Nothing was paid. Install: the install form was sent at 14:28 in our own tab; Shopify showed the Install app dialog with View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data, and the install was approved at about 14:28:50. The app opened straight on the Free plan, with no plan choice, no separate account and no demo, on a screen Welcome to Vify Order Printer with a step guide at 0 of 4. Core action, an invoice for the test order #1001, a little over 1 minute after the start of the install (about 14:29:20) and 3 clicks from the order list: Orders, order #1001, the printer icon, Print invoice. The result was a page called invoice_1001.pdf on a Vify address (api-pdf.vify.ai), which is an HTML print view that calls window.print(); the browser tab stayed on the print dialog. IMPORTANT about the evidence image of the invoice: image 03 is NOT a screenshot of the PDF. Because the tab hung on the print dialog, we rendered the HTML of that same invoice page ourselves, locally and headless, and took the image from that rendering. It shows what the page contains, but we did not open or check the real PDF file, so page size, fonts and the real print result were not seen. The invoice contains INVOICE, the store block, SHIPPING ADDRESS, Invoice Number: #1001, Order Date: 2026-11-16 08:59:20, the item The Collection Snowboard: Liquid 1 x $749.95, Grand total $749.95, PAYMENT INFORMATION, a QR code, Thank you for your purchase! and the branding Created by VIFY on the Free plan, with a grey LOGO placeholder. On the Free plan the app says You are using FREE plan. You can only view the latest 50 orders. and, for removing the Vify branding in the PDF invoice, Please contact support to verify your store in order to have this feature for free. The download menu per order has Download invoice, Download packing slip, Download refund and Download by language (greyed out). Plans: Plans (Monthly) shows FREE $0, STARTER $8.99 USD/Month, PREMIUM $29.99 and ULTIMATE $69.99, with 14-day free trial with any plan, This offer only applies to your first charge. and Cancel anytime on the paid plans. Starter lists Branding removal, Invoice Edit, Email Automation, Unlimited orders and Auto-detect language by customer locale; Premium adds Quotes, Send emails with store's email address, Commercial invoice, Invoice Generator and Online Storage; Ultimate adds 1 Custom template of your design and Free customization. Peppol, ZUGFeRD, Factur-X and VAT numbers are not in the plan lists. The listing and the dossier name Starter at $10.99, while the app shows $8.99. The Yearly view was not opened. Checkout: Start 14-day free trial on Starter opened the Shopify Approve subscription screen: STARTER PLAN, $8,99 USD every 30 days, You have a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec., Subtotal $8,99 plus any applicable taxes, Total $8,99 Due 1 Dec, and an Add payment method row. Approve was greyed out, the sentence about a test charge was NOT on the screen and a payment method was asked, so we did not approve, no card was entered, and we pressed Cancel. Cancelling: no paid plan was ever started, so there was nothing to cancel. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the row of the app and Uninstall; the dialog says that a request will be sent to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information, and a reason is required (the button is greyed out until one is chosen). The app was uninstalled afterwards. Not tested: the automatic invoice email, bulk processing, the Invoice generator, quotes, the commercial invoice, e-invoice formats, removing the branding, editing templates, the Yearly plans, and opening the real PDF. Clean up: no theme changes; the app was uninstalled; our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The invoice opened as an HTML print view that called the print dialog and left the tab hanging, the invoice carried Vify branding and a logo placeholder on the Free plan, the Free plan only shows the latest 50 orders, and the Starter approval screen needs a payment method and has no test charge sentence.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Vify Order Printer on a Shopify development store: the install on the Free plan, an invoice for a test order in about 1 minute and 3 clicks (the tab stayed on the print dialog, so the evidence image is our own local rendering of the invoice HTML and not a screenshot of the PDF), the plan screen, the Shopify approval screen for Starter (not approved, a payment method was asked) and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Nothing was paid. Install: the install form was sent at 14:28 in our own tab; Shopify showed the Install app dialog with View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data, and the install was approved at about 14:28:50. The app opened straight on the Free plan, with no plan choice, no separate account and no demo, on a screen Welcome to Vify Order Printer with a step guide at 0 of 4. Core action, an invoice for the test order #1001, a little over 1 minute after the start of the install (about 14:29:20) and 3 clicks from the order list: Orders, order #1001, the printer icon, Print invoice. The result was a page called invoice_1001.pdf on a Vify address (api-pdf.vify.ai), which is an HTML print view that calls window.print(); the browser tab stayed on the print dialog. IMPORTANT about the evidence image of the invoice: image 03 is NOT a screenshot of the PDF. Because the tab hung on the print dialog, we rendered the HTML of that same invoice page ourselves, locally and headless, and took the image from that rendering. It shows what the page contains, but we did not open or check the real PDF file, so page size, fonts and the real print result were not seen. The invoice contains INVOICE, the store block, SHIPPING ADDRESS, Invoice Number: #1001, Order Date: 2026-11-16 08:59:20, the item The Collection Snowboard: Liquid 1 x $749.95, Grand total $749.95, PAYMENT INFORMATION, a QR code, Thank you for your purchase! and the branding Created by VIFY on the Free plan, with a grey LOGO placeholder. On the Free plan the app says You are using FREE plan. You can only view the latest 50 orders. and, for removing the Vify branding in the PDF invoice, Please contact support to verify your store in order to have this feature for free. The download menu per order has Download invoice, Download packing slip, Download refund and Download by language (greyed out). Plans: Plans (Monthly) shows FREE $0, STARTER $8.99 USD/Month, PREMIUM $29.99 and ULTIMATE $69.99, with 14-day free trial with any plan, This offer only applies to your first charge. and Cancel anytime on the paid plans. Starter lists Branding removal, Invoice Edit, Email Automation, Unlimited orders and Auto-detect language by customer locale; Premium adds Quotes, Send emails with store's email address, Commercial invoice, Invoice Generator and Online Storage; Ultimate adds 1 Custom template of your design and Free customization. Peppol, ZUGFeRD, Factur-X and VAT numbers are not in the plan lists. The listing and the dossier name Starter at $10.99, while the app shows $8.99. The Yearly view was not opened. Checkout: Start 14-day free trial on Starter opened the Shopify Approve subscription screen: STARTER PLAN, $8,99 USD every 30 days, You have a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec., Subtotal $8,99 plus any applicable taxes, Total $8,99 Due 1 Dec, and an Add payment method row. Approve was greyed out, the sentence about a test charge was NOT on the screen and a payment method was asked, so we did not approve, no card was entered, and we pressed Cancel. Cancelling: no paid plan was ever started, so there was nothing to cancel. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the row of the app and Uninstall; the dialog says that a request will be sent to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information, and a reason is required (the button is greyed out until one is chosen). The app was uninstalled afterwards. Not tested: the automatic invoice email, bulk processing, the Invoice generator, quotes, the commercial invoice, e-invoice formats, removing the branding, editing templates, the Yearly plans, and opening the real PDF. Clean up: no theme changes; the app was uninstalled; our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The invoice opened as an HTML print view that called the print dialog and left the tab hanging, the invoice carried Vify branding and a logo placeholder on the Free plan, the Free plan only shows the latest 50 orders, and the Starter approval screen needs a payment method and has no test charge sentence.
